description: Ask SketchXFlow to BUILD something for real (a website, web app or mobile app) at a fixed price from the public price list. Opens a project and returns the AI consultant's first question. Free; nothing is committed until a proposal is accepted on the website.

brief.description: What you need built, in your own words — who it's for and what it should do. Paste an existing brief if you have one.

persona.description: Who you are, so the consultant talks your language: non_technical_founder, business_owner, developer (technical founder too), product_manager, agency (building for a client), or other.

title.description: A short working title, e.g. 'Clinic booking site'.
